name: Sugihara Kyouko
source:
She is an ordinary housewife with a salaryman husband and a bratty son.

She is what one would call a serious and sensible person. She is a fastidious housewife who did not allow her husband to have sex with her until their wedding night.

She is frustrated by the lack of sex with her husband, which has left her with a ripe body, and she is frustrated every day.
